decisions.reason: The same source message already has a complete MODIFY setting google_play_language_count to 77 under this Requirement, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
Selecting all supported store languages does not alter the existing requirement to render correctly in RTL locales.
The language-coverage selection does not change the requirement to provide an iOS Privacy Manifest.
The selected App Store language count does not modify the existing size-optimization goal or localized tutorial asset strategy.
Language coverage is unrelated to removing the unused READ_PHONE_STATE permission.
The localization coverage decision does not change the iOS platform-modernization or deprecated-API requirements.
The number of App Store languages does not affect the requirement for valid iOS signing certificates.
The Android language-count choice does not itself change the existing size-optimization goal or reusable localized-asset strategy.
The store-language selection does not modify Android platform compatibility, deprecated-API refactoring, or maintainability requirements.
